page_title: Item:Legendary Bracers of the Hidden Blade

enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +13: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Assassinate +15: +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Quality Deception +2: +2 Quality bonus to hit and +3 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Insightful Bluff +10: Passive: +10 Insight bonus to the Bluff skill.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
